## E — Market signal: vehicle title, registration, plates, inspection and insurance
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (NJ-VEH-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: new residents moving to New Jersey may search for a simple checklist of registration, inspection and insurance deadlines, which suggests a new-resident checklist angle to test later.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: New Jersey learner demand, pass rates, pricing, voice-of-customer quotes and ad hooks for the vehicle title, registration, plates, inspection and insurance topic are unresearched.
